title: Co-op v0.9.4: grab and sprint for the main pawn
intro: Co-op starts by itself; controller only. Stand near an enemy or something grabbable.

steps.text: Square next to an enemy or object (grab)
Run with the stick, tap Triangle (sprint)
Run with the stick, click L3 (sprint)
Hold L1, tap Square (skill 1 - no grab)

probes.pacts:
if not ACTS then
  ACTS = {}
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.CharacterInput.Action")
  local gm = sdk.find_type_definition("app.CharacterInput"):get_method("getInputFlag")
  for _, f in ipairs(td:get_fields()) do
    if f:is_static() and f:get_name() ~= "value__" then
      local ok, id = pcall(f.get_data, f, nil)
      if ok and type(id) == "number" and id >= 0 and id < 63 then
        local flag = 1 << id
        local ok2, fv = pcall(gm.call, gm, nil, id)
        if ok2 and type(fv) == "number" and fv > 0 then flag = fv end
        ACTS[#ACTS + 1] = { f:get_name(), flag }
      end
    end
  end
end
local on = H.pawn(0):call("get_Input"):get_field("ButtonOnFlags") or 0
local t = {}
for _, a in ipairs(ACTS) do if (on & a[2]) == a[2] and a[2] ~= 0 then t[#t + 1] = a[1] end end
return table.concat(t, "+")
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
